title: EO atlas simulation inputs v1
description: Cross-section input structure. Runtime validation additionally checks positive material tensors, geometry coverage, references, voltage normalization, numerical limits, model/field consistency of the line block and stage completeness (EO arm windows, RF loss declarations) when a stage is requested. loaded_line and eo_response are recognised but not implemented. Since 2026-10-14 (DevLog-026): params with '=' expressions, template (generates geometry), study/studies (parametric sweeps), materials.<m>.library.

metal_in_window.description: Metal in the optical window. Scalar: reject | absent | pec_scalar. Vector: reject | absent | pec (pec_scalar maps to pec) | lossy (needs metal_permittivity with a provenance entry).

group_index_from.description: perturbation (default): first-order d n_eff / d lambda of the same eigen solve (scalar: optics.groupIndex perturbation; vector: mode.ng); finite_difference_wavelength: central difference over +-min(0.01 um, lambda/100) (extra eigen solves); fixed: ng_fixed is a configured input

eo.description: EO overlap inputs (required by the eo_overlap stage). Arm windows are explicit; terminal_drive is a label (V_t is the full terminal difference) and must agree with line.differential. arm_windows is required by the eo_overlap stage unless a template generates it.

solver.description: Optical mode solver: full-vector Nedelec/Lagrange FEM (default since 2026-10-15, DevLog-026 round 5) or the approximate scalar FEM (results labelled scalar_optical_approximate; rejected for TM EO runs). The run option `solver` overrides it.

vector_order.description: Element order of the vector solver

metal_permittivity.description: Optical relative permittivity per metal, [eps', eps''] with eps = eps' - j eps'' at the configured wavelength; only with metal_in_window: lossy; each needs provenance optics.metal_permittivity.<metal> with a locator or citation (no default exists)

by.description: te_fraction (default): the mode_index-th mode of the polarisation family by n_eff; confinement: the mode_index-th of the family ranked by power in `region` (vector only)

max_metal_power_fraction.description: lossy metal only: largest power fraction in conductor regions accepted for the selected mode; above it (or when the mode is closer to a planar surface-plasmon index than to the metal-absent mode) the run fails

num_modes.description: compute at least this many modes per optical solve for the mode table (DevLog-031); the selected mode and its selection rule are unchanged

length_mm.description: electrode length per arm (mm); vpi_dc_v = VpiL / length

conductor_loss_model.description: Explicit conductor loss model; skin_effect_wheeler uses recessed-geometry solves (DevLog-012 item 4).

dielectric_loss_model.description: Required by rf_line unless from_paper_alpha. tan_delta_regions needs tan_delta_rf (or a dielectric sigma_Sm) on every region material.

rf_loss_table.description: Paper attenuation input (from_paper_alpha); never an independent prediction; needs a provenance locator.

params.description: name -> {value, unit, description}; value is a number or an expression of other params (cycles are errors). Overridable per run (runCrossSection params option) and swept by studies.

anyOf.description: Partial {perp} or {par}: only together with library (merges one level deep over the library value)

rotation_deg.description: CCW rotation of the lab frame about the propagation axis seen from +z: x' = cos t x + sin t y (fixed sense 2026-10-07)

tan_delta_rf.description: RF loss tangent; absent = unknown (never zero)

dispersion.description: Library dispersion key (defaults to the material name when the library has it)

n_complex.description: Reserved; not used by the engine (real-metal optics is not modelled)

library.description: Key of engine/data/materials.json `library` (e.g. lithium_niobate_congruent, silicon_dioxide, silicon, gold_bulk_293k). Supplies eps_r, r_pm_per_v, sigma_Sm, conductor and dispersion; config keys override (eps_r perp/par and named r coefficients merge one level deep). Provenance class standard_reference.

vpi_convention.description: Required for a Vpi target to be evaluated; must match the engine drive convention (no silent conversion). mzm_differential = MZM V_pi against the full terminal difference V+ - V- (data/schema/devices.schema.yaml convention (q), 2026-10-07), the engine V_t.

element_order.description: Electrostatic element order: 1 = P1, 2 = P2 Lagrange on the same mesh (default 2 since 2026-10-15, DevLog-026 round 2)

p2_mesh_factor.description: Electrostatic mesh-scale factor applied when element_order is 2 (default 2: P2 at about P1 cost; DevLog-026 round 5); run option p2MeshFactor overrides it

expression.description: Arithmetic expression of params with a leading '=' (numbers, params, + - * / ^, parentheses, unary minus, min, max, sqrt, abs, sin, cos, tan, pi); evaluated before validation. The unit implied by the key suffix must match the units of the params in a sum of param terms.

template.description: Parametric cross-section generating `geometry` and optics.eo.arm_windows (engine/src/templates.mjs). Frame: y = 0 at the BOX top, x = 0 at arm A; signal electrode left of arm A; arm B mirrored about the signal centre.

substrate_thickness_um.description: substrate kept in the model; the domain bottom is at -(box + substrate) unless domain.y_um is given

waveguide_offset_um.description: displacement of the waveguide from the gap centre toward the signal electrode

optical_window.description: defaults (numerical): half width = min(gap-edge distance - 0.1 um, footprint half width + 2 um); y from -min(BOX, 1.5 um) to film (strip) top + 1 um

study.description: Parametric study over params (engine/src/sweep.mjs). Axes nest: the first axis is outermost, the last varies fastest.

vpi_convention.description: Required for a Vpi target to be evaluated; must match the engine drive convention (no silent conversion). mzm_differential = MZM V_pi against the full terminal difference V+ - V- (data/schema/devices.schema.yaml convention (q), 2026-10-07), the engine V_t.

at.description: param values of the sweep point this target belongs to
